Hi all —

Thanks Jordan. Samantha — I pulled the invoice and usage windows; below is the proposed treatment. I've attached a CSV with the line-item math (proposed-credit-allocation.csv).

Summary of facts we have:
- Baseline subscription: 20 seats, monthly renewal charged Mar 8 for period Mar 8–Apr 7.
- Short-term top-up: 5 seats activated Mar 1 2027 09:00 UTC, deactivated Mar 7 2027 18:00 UTC.
- Per-seat monthly rate (as billed on your account): $300/seat/month.

Calculation (standard calendar-proration by day):
- Overlap days: Mar 1 (inclusive) through Mar 7 (inclusive) = 7 days.
- March daily seat rate = $300 / 31 = $9.6774193548/day.
- Overlap charge for 5 seats = 5 * 7 * $9.6774193548 = $338.71 (rounded to cents).

What happened on invoice: the system billed the short-term top-up as a full-month charge for March line-item and separately billed the Mar 8 renewal for the baseline seats. The correct net impact is that the customer owes for the short window only; full-month charge for the top-up should be credited back and replaced with the $338.71 prorated amount.

Proposal (choose one):
1) Credit memo of $## (full-month top-up amount) and new short-window charge of $338.71 — preserves original invoice for audit, issues separate credit memo.
2) Revised March invoice that nets out the full-month top-up and replaces with the prorated line — single document for AP.

Given your PO and net-30 terms, option 2 is usually easiest for customers unless your accounting requires a separate memo. If you confirm option 2, we will:
- Void the original March top-up line on invoice 20270301-4589 (system note: superseded),
- Issue corrected invoice 20270305-4589R with net owed updated,
- Provide a short reconciliation CSV and an explanation line for your audit team.

Attachment: proposed-credit-allocation.csv (text/csv)

If you confirm activation/deactivation timestamps above I will finalize the amount and have Stephanie schedule the invoice revision.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
